title: Home Purchase Agreement Ratification and the Signing Deposit Deadline
content:
**Article 4 — Ratification.**

4.1 A Home Purchase Agreement is ratified when every deposit due at signing under the agreement's earnest money terms has posted and has not been returned.

4.2 All deposits due at signing must post within the collection's signing deposit business days after the contract date. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Calloway holidays, counting starts the next business day after the contract date, and a deposit posting on the last counted business day is on time.

4.3 If they have not, the system voids the agreement, moving it from pending ratification to cancelled, and every dollar posted is refunded with the reason void unfunded, transferred reservation funds included. No fee is charged on a void.

4.4 The dates compared are the contract date on the agreement record and the posting dates of the deposits on the agreement ledger.

**Commentary to Article 4.**

*Posting and not returned.* A signing deposit that posted and was then returned unpaid does not count as posted for ratification.

*Boundary.* Where the collection's figure is 3 business days, the counted days are the first, second and third business days after the contract date. A deposit posting on the third counted business day is on time; a deposit first posting on the fourth is not.

*Hypothetical calendar.* A buyer signs on a Monday in a week with no Calloway holiday, in a collection with a 3-business-day figure. The counted business days are Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday; a signing deposit posting on Thursday is on time. In a collection with a 2-business-day figure, the counted days are Tuesday and Wednesday. A Calloway holiday falling in the period is not counted, which moves the last counted business day later.

*Outcome table.*

| Every signing deposit posted, not returned, by the last counted business day | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Yes | The agreement is ratified |
| No | The agreement is voided to cancelled; every dollar posted is refunded with reason void unfunded, no fee |
